name: Ring Sort: Color Hoop Puzzle
description: Stack colored wooden rings, fill each peg with one color and watch it snap shut. Play the free demo right in your browser.

name: Marble Rush: Quick Brain Game
description: Biggest or smallest? Spot the right marble and tap its color before time runs out. One rule. One tap. One more try.

name: Find Numbers 1 to 100
description: A hundred numbers. One sharp eye. Find and tap them in order, challenge a friend or take on the AI.

name: Last Tower: Monster Siege
description: One archer. One tower. A whole horde to stop. Aim your bow, discover powerful skills and hold the line.

name: Stickman Archer Duel: Bow War
description: Read the wind, land the perfect headshot and challenge the champions of eight civilizations. Pull, aim and let the arrows fly.

name: Stickman Block Defense
description: Stack your wall. Clear a line. Fire a volley. A new puzzle-defense adventure with mighty heroes and epic castle sieges.

name: Rooftop Last Stand
description: Hold the roof. Survive the night. Aim, land headshots and crack open supply crates between waves to power up your arsenal.

name: Arrow Escape: Tap Away Puzzle
description: Tap a paper arrow and watch it fly off the board. Find the right order, unlock keys, melt ice and decorate Pip's cozy home.

name: Bolt Pop: Unscrew Puzzle
description: Unscrew colorful screws, drop them into matching toolboxes and watch the plates fall. 300 levels, each proven solvable, and a Robot Garage to decorate.

name: Star Dial: Rotate Ring Puzzle
description: Tap or drag the rings to line up the gaps and free the shining star. 300 levels, each proven solvable, gears and locked rings, boosters and a Stargazer Loft to decorate.

name: Wool Bloom: Unravel Yarn Art
description: Tap spools to pull loose stitches out of cozy wool pictures and unravel them row by row. 300 levels, each proven solvable, boosters and a Cozy Nook to decorate.

name: Number Hunt: Find the Number
description: Find the hidden numbers in order, crack each case with the little detective and train your focus. A cozy number puzzle that plays offline.

name: Puzzle Box: Daily Brain Mix
description: One box, many brain games: Number Hunt, Arrow Escape, Ring Sort, Bolt Pop and Wool Bloom. Play the Daily Mix, keep your streak and fill your Trophy Room.

name: Trace Buddy: ABC & 123 Tracing
description: Kids trace A–Z, a–z and 0–9 stroke by stroke with Buddy the owl. Stars, stickers, no ads.

name: Tile Express: Mosaic Train
description: Send toy trains around the track to collect matching tiles and reveal mosaic pictures. 200+ calm levels, free undo, hints and a little station to decorate.

name: Sandy Pop: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Drop colorful blocks that melt into flowing sand, link one color wall to wall and pop giant chain reactions. 300 calm levels, free undo and hints.

name: Bug Parade: Garden Spray
description: Hold to spray! Splash a cute parade of bugs into butterflies, pick power-up cards, beat giant centipedes and decorate your butterfly garden.
